meta_description: Docksey Plumbing Services in Stoke-on-Trent. Emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Same-day response, no call-out charge. Call 07502 731688 today.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Plumber — Rapid Response in Stoke
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, blocked drains, boiler breakdowns—we arrive fast and fix right, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to new installations, we handle everything your home needs.

services.title: Emergency Call-Outs
services.desc: Burst pipes, flooding, or no water? We aim to be with you within the hour, 24/7. No hidden charges—we quote upfront and get the job done right.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Faulty heating in winter is unbearable. We diagnose and repair boilers fast, carry common parts on the van, and offer annual servicing to keep breakdowns rare.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Pipes
services.desc: Slow drains, nasty smells, or backed-up waste? We use proven techniques to clear blockages and prevent future problems without damaging your pipework.

services.title: Leaks & Water Damage
services.desc: Slow leaks destroy homes silently. We pinpoint the source, repair it, and advise on drying out your property to avoid structural damage and mould.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installation
services.desc: New tap, full bathroom refit, or kitchen plumbing—we handle design advice, installation, and testing so everything works perfectly on day one.

services.title: Radiator & Heating Installation
services.desc: Warm rooms and lower bills. We install new radiators, upgrade heating systems, and balance your central heating for comfort and efficiency across the home.

about_pullquote: I started Docksey because I was tired of dodgy plumbers charging locals over the odds.
about_para_1: Docksey Plumbing was founded in 2012 by a frustrated homeowner who'd had enough of unreliable tradesmen and inflated invoices. After years of plumbing work across the Midlands, we saw a gap for honest, fast, no-nonsense service in Stoke-on-Trent. We've grown steadily by keeping our prices fair and our word solid—every job done right, first time.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we show up when we say we will, explain what's wrong in plain English, and never talk you into work you don't need. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned installation, you get the same calm, professional approach. We're proud to be a local family business with roots in the community we serve.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Burst pipe on a Saturday morning—absolute nightmare. Called Docksey at 8am and Jamie was here by 9. He found the problem, explained it without the jargon, and had it repaired by lunchtime. Fair price too. Can't ask for better than that.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a leaking radiator that was ruining the bedroom wall. Rang in the evening expecting to wait weeks. They came out the next morning, replaced it, and disposed of the old one. Professional and quick. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: New boiler installation—bit nervous about the cost, but they were upfront with the quote from the start. Fitted it brilliantly, tested everything, and even showed me how to bleed the radiators. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David H.
